Summarise Backyard Ultra Runner Performance

summarise_stopped_runners.Rd

Summarises the performance of stopped runners from the 2026 Backyard Ultra World Team Championships. Results can be grouped by nation or competition class.

Usage

summarise_stopped_runners(data = wtc_stopped, group = "nation", min_yards = 0)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing runner information. Defaults to wtc_stopped.

group

Variable used to group results. Either "nation" or "class".

min_yards

Minimum number of completed yards required for a runner to be included.

Value

A data frame containing the group, runner count, mean yards, median yards, maximum yards and total yards.

Examples

summarise_stopped_runners(group = "nation")
